lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition K2Mg12 (reduced formula KMg6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg centers show 12- and 14-neighbor environments, while K centers have 12 Mg neighbors, with distances spanning roughly 3.16–3.38 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg–Mg polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–K polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
